changes: Twelve complete, composited GIF frames exported as lossless PNGs. No cropping or recoloring.
clock_basis: Times are transcribed from the filename printed inside each radar frame and interpreted as UTC, consistent with the NWS event chronology. The printed label does not itself state a time zone; this clock interpretation is explicit, not an independent calibration.
interpretation: Only a preceding frame up to four minutes old is shown. The radar view covers the wider storm area and is not registered as a geographic overlay on this map.
